name: claude-city
description: A living city visualization of your local Claude Code sessions and agents.

claudeCity.claudePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `claude` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH`.

claudeCity.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Polling interval (seconds) for `claude agents --json --all` while a City view is visible.

enumDescriptions: Show demo data only when the Claude CLI is unavailable (clearly labelled DEMO).
claudeCity.demoMode.description: Controls when demo data is shown.

claudeCity.discoverHistoricalProjects.markdownDescription: Best effort: register every project found under `~/.claude/projects` as a building, even if it has no session within `#claudeCity.history.maxAgeDays#`. Never required.

claudeCity.workspaceRoots.markdownDescription: Folders that contain your projects. Every direct subfolder is shown as a building (hidden folders and `node_modules`, `bin`, `obj`, `out`, `dist` are skipped). Rescanned on activation, on **Refresh** and every 2 minutes: new subfolders appear automatically, vanished ones are shown as "folder not found". Usually filled by **Claude City: Import Workspaces from Folder…**.

claudeCity.history.importSessions.markdownDescription: Import past Claude Code sessions from the local transcripts in `~/.claude/projects` and show recent ones as rooms and archived ones as boxes in each building's **basement**. Read-only and best effort: only the first and last 64 KB of each transcript are read (the transcript format is not a stable API). Live sessions always win over archived ones.

claudeCity.history.maxAgeDays.markdownDescription: Only import past sessions whose transcript changed within this many days.

claudeCity.history.maxSessionsPerWorkspa.markdownDescription: Archived sessions per building sent with full details (most recent first). Older ones come from a lightweight index: they are still counted on the house, drawn as boxes in the building's basement (up to 60, then "+N") and listed in its detail panel (up to 200 per building).

claudeCity.history.recentDays.markdownDescription: Fallback only. When Claude Code's own archive marker can be read (see `#claudeCity.history.useClaudeCodeArchive#`), exactly the sessions archived in Claude Code are archived and all other past sessions are **recent** (Claude Code auto-archives after `claudeCode.archiveInactiveSessions` days itself). When the marker is off or unavailable, past sessions active within this many days are **recent** (rooms with a resting character), older ones go to the building's **basement** archive. `0` archives every session that is not running.

claudeCity.history.maxRecentPerWorkspace.markdownDescription: Maximum recent (resting) rooms per building (most recent first). Further recent sessions are counted and listed in the building's detail panel.

claudeCity.history.useClaudeCodeArchive.markdownDescription: Best effort: treat sessions you archived in the Claude Code extension's session list (manually or via `claudeCode.archiveInactiveSessions`) as archived. Reads only the list of archived session ids from VS Code's global state database (read-only). When available it is the only rule (no additional age limit). This relies on undocumented Claude Code internals; when they cannot be read, `#claudeCity.history.recentDays#` decides.

claudeCity.hookBridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Run the loopback-only (127.0.0.1) live-event server that receives Claude Code hook events. Hooks themselves are only added to Claude settings via **Claude City: Install Live Event Hooks…**.

claudeCity.hookBridge.port.markdownDescription: Fixed loopback port of the live-event server. Changing it requires re-running **Install Live Event Hooks…** (the hook URL contains the port).

claudeCity.ambient.dayNight.description: Tint the city according to the local time of day (static tint, no animation).
